# SyncNos Store Listing Copy

Manual source copy for browser-store listings. Keep user-visible capability and privacy claims aligned with the README and `PRIVACY.md`; localized manifest descriptions remain in `public/_locales/*/messages.json`.

## English

### Short description

Local-first clipper for AI chats, articles, and useful video context. Sync to Notion, Obsidian, Feishu, or GitHub.

### Long description

SyncNos is an open-source, local-first browser clipper for AI conversations, web articles, and supported YouTube/Bilibili video pages.

Capture first, decide later:

- Save supported AI conversations.
- Extract readable web content and relevant metadata.
- Save video-page context and already-loaded transcripts when available.
- Add local article comments and highlights.
- Browse and organize captured content locally.

Then, when you choose:

- Sync to Notion, Obsidian, Feishu (Lark), or GitHub.
- Export selected items as Markdown or JSON.
- Create a local Backup ZIP for recovery.

Captured content is stored locally first. Network transmission occurs only for features that contact a configured provider, OAuth service, image host, or other destination described in the privacy policy.

Open source: https://github.com/chiimagnus/SyncNos

## 简体中文

### 简短描述

本地优先的开源剪藏器：保存 AI 对话、文章和视频页面内容，可同步到 Notion、Obsidian、飞书或 GitHub。

### 详细描述

SyncNos 是一款本地优先的开源浏览器剪藏器，用来保存 AI 对话、网页文章和受支持的 YouTube / Bilibili 视频页面内容。

先采集，再决定去向：

- 保存受支持的 AI 对话；
- 提取网页正文和相关元数据；
- 保存视频页面上下文，以及页面已经加载的字幕 / transcript；
- 添加本地文章评论与划线；
- 在本地浏览、整理已采集内容。

需要时再：

- 同步到 Notion、Obsidian、飞书或 GitHub；
- 导出选中的 Markdown / JSON；
- 创建本地 Backup ZIP 用于恢复。

采集内容默认先保存在本地。只有需要联系已配置 Provider、OAuth 服务、图片主机或隐私政策中说明的其它目标时，相关功能才会产生网络传输。

开源代码：https://github.com/chiimagnus/SyncNos
